name: manuel
description: Commands for the command line game

commands.man:
man - This command lists all available commands and their descriptions.
man [command name]
commands.dash:
dash - A quick movement
dash [parameters]
"-f" to dash forward
"-b" to dash backward
"-l" to dash left
"-r" to dash right
commands.walk:
walk - A slow movement
walk [parameters]
"-f" to walk forward
"-b" to walk backward
"-l" to walk left
"-r" to walk right
commands.attack:
attack - Attack an enemy in front of you
attack
commands.circle:
circle - Move in a semi circle motion
circle [parameters]
"-l" to circle left
"-r" to circle right
commands.retreat:
retreat - quickly move backwards to create distance between you and an enemy
retreat
commands.turn_r:
turn_r - rotate to the right 90 degrees
turn_r
commands.turn_l:
tunr_l - rotate to the left 90 degrees
turn_l
commands.hit_wall:
hit_wall - A conditional to check if you collide with a wall
Use this command in an if statement when scripting to check if you hit a wall
commands.in_range:
in_range - A conditional to check if an enemy is withing your "range"
Use this command in an if statement when scripting to check if an enemy is within your "range"
commands.ch_range:
ch_range - change the radius of your "range"
ch_range [integer]
commands.move:
move - A more freeform command to move in a direction, change speed, and stop moving
move [parameters]
"-f" to move forward
"-b" to move backward
"-l" to move left
"-r" to move right
"-s" to change speed between 1 - 10
"-q" to stop moving
commands.turn:
turn - A more freeform command to rotate in a direction, change speed, and stop rotating
turn [parameters]
"-l" to rotate left
"-r" to rotate right
"-s" to change speed between 1 - 10
"-q" to stop rotating
commands.cancel_process:
cancel_process - A command that cancels all movement, rotation, and scripts that are currently running
cancel_process
"ctr + c" is the key combination to run this command
commands.cd:
cd - A command to change the current directory between "plyr" and "inv"
cd [directory name]
commands.ls:
ls - A command to list the contents of the current directory
ls [subdirectory name]
commands.use:
use - A command to use an item you have collected
use [item name]
commands.return_to_terminal:
return_to_terminal - A command to return to the terminal if your cursor loses focus. This command is most commonly used when scripting
return_to_terminal
"ctr + q" is the key to run this command
commands.cat:
cat - A command to read and edit the contents of a file or create a new file
cat [file name]
commands.save:
save - A command to save the changes made to your script
save
commands.run:
run - A command to run a script you have written
run [script name]
commands.closeMenu:
closeMenu - A command to close the full terminal window
closeMenu
"ctr + c" is a key that also closes the terminal window
